logp.method_description: Weighted amounts of gallium complexes were partitioned between water and n-octanol for 2 h at room temperature by the shake flask method. Gallium concentrations in the aqueous phase before (C0) and after partitioning (Caq) were measured using the same analytical techniques, from which the partition coefficients were calculated as log P = log (C0 - Caq)/Caq.
